TranscriptAction.description:
One action. The object for its family is set, when it recorded any of that family's fields; every other
family's object is `null`.

code.description: Set for a code action (`code`): what it ran with, returned and printed.

duration_seconds.description: How long it took, in seconds. `null` when not recorded.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

filter.description: Set for a filter (`filter`, `filter_v2`): which case held.

flow_transfer.description: Set when the call moved to another flow (`transfer_workflow`).

http.description: Set for an API request (`api_request`): recorded request and response details.

name.description: The action's name, as the flow labels it.
name.title: Name

notification.description: Set for a notification about the call (`notification`).

redial.description: Set for a redial (`redial`): when the customer will be called again.

stage.description: When it ran: before the call, during it, or after it ended. Known values: `pre_call`, `in_call`, `post_call`. More can be added, so handle values you don't recognize.
stage.title: Stage

status.description: Whether it succeeded. An API request succeeded on a 2xx answer and failed on any other or on a timeout; a webhook by whether its data arrived; a redial when one was scheduled; any other action as it recorded. `null` when it recorded no outcome. Known values: `succeeded`, `failed`. More can be added, so handle values you don't recognize.
status.title: Status

transfer.description: Set for a call transfer (`transfer_call`): where it went, or how a warm transfer ended.

type.description: What kind of action ran, as recorded: usually the type of the block that ran it, such as `api_request`, `send_sms` or `transfer_call`, or a step the agent runs itself, such as `outbound_variables` before an outbound call. `null` when not recorded.
type.title: Type

variables.description: Set for `outbound_variables`: the values the outbound call started with. Credentials Phonely recognizes are replaced with `***` (best effort).
variables.title: Variables

webhook.description: Set for a webhook that delivers data before the call (`webhook`).

get.description:
A call's transcript: the conversation and everything the agent did, in order.

Entries are the turns the agent and the customer spoke, the flows it entered and the blocks it chose, the
variables it stored, the knowledge it retrieved, the actions the flow ran, and events on the line such as
transfers. Each entry sets the one object its `type` names. A call in progress has a partial transcript.

Actions include recorded details for API requests, code, transfers, texts, emails, and more. Request details
may contain template placeholders. Credentials Phonely recognizes are replaced with `***`: by their name (such
as `api_key` or `password`) or their format (such as a Stripe or OpenAI key). This is best effort: a secret under
a name and in a format that don't say so can show, so keep credentials in a block's headers: every header value
except plain ones such as `Content-Type` is always masked.
